description: You are a United Airlines Captain based at Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD). Set up your Flight Crew View profile before your first trip. Complete all of the following: (1) change your display name to 'Capt. Rodriguez | ORD', (2) set your position to Captain, (3) configure your home airport and base/activity airport both to ORD, and (4) add three crew colleagues as friends: fo.james@united.aero, fa.chen@united.aero, fa.garcia@united.aero. Login credentials: cuasuite@gmail.com / #Aa123456aA (Friend/Family account). The app starts on the Friends page.
